当需要将AI推理框架对接到HarmonyOS的AI加速硬件（NPU）上执行模型推理时使用本Kit
NNRt提供统一的Native接口，让AI推理框架无需关心底层硬件差异，实现跨芯片推理计算
开发者可以按照模型构造、模型编译、推理执行三个阶段完成开发流程
当需要直接使用离线模型在特定AI硬件上执行推理时也可使用本Kit
通过离线模型编译接口传入硬件厂商提供的离线模型文件，可以在特定AI硬件上快速加载和执行推理，适合对模型加载速度要求较高的场景
接入 NNRt 让模型在 NPU/GPU/CPU 上统一执行 / Integrate NNRt to run models uniformly on NPU/GPU/CPU
加载离线 AI 模型文件并在端侧完成推理 / Load an offline AI model file and perform on-device inference
编译神经网络模型并缓存编译结果提升二次启动速度 / Compile a neural network model and cache artifacts to speed up subsequent launches
为图像分类或目标检测接入硬件加速推理 / Add hardware-accelerated inference for image classification or object detection
用共享内存传递输入输出张量减少数据拷贝 / Pass input and output tensors with shared memory to reduce data copying
设置推理性能模式、功耗策略和 FP16 精度 / Configure inference performance mode, power policy, and FP16 precision
指定在某个 AI 加速设备上运行模型 / Run a model on a specific AI accelerator device
查询设备支持的 AI 计算后端并选择可用硬件 / Query supported AI compute backends and choose available hardware
构建自定义计算图并执行端侧神经网络推理 / Build a custom computation graph and execute on-device neural network inference
让应用里的 OCR、语音或视觉模型跨芯片运行 / Make OCR, speech, or vision models run across different chips
管理模型输入输出张量和推理会话生命周期 / Manage model input-output tensors and the inference session lifecycle
为重复推理任务复用已编译模型减少初始化耗时 / Reuse compiled models for repeated inference tasks to reduce initialization time
do_not_use_when: 需求是做中英文分词、实体抽取，识别日期、地址、电话号码或电子邮件等命名实体，应改用 natural-language-kit / The task is Chinese/English tokenization and entity extraction, including dates, addresses, phone numbers, or email named entities; use natural-language-kit instead
preconditions: 目标设备与HarmonyOS版本已提供Neural Network Runtime能力，且设备实际支持NPU/相关AI加速硬件 / The target device and HarmonyOS version provide Neural Network Runtime capability, and the device actually supports an NPU or relevant AI acceleration hardware
工程可使用Native/C接口进行开发，并已正确链接NNRt相关头文件与库 / The project can use Native/C APIs and has correctly linked the NNRt headers and libraries
待执行的模型或离线模型格式与目标硬件及NNRt支持范围兼容，所需算子在支持列表内 / The model or offline model to run is compatible with the target hardware and NNRt support scope, and its required operators are within the supported set
如果使用模型缓存、离线模型或共享内存，应用已具备对应文件路径与内存资源的可访问性 / If model cache, offline models, or shared memory are used, the app has access to the required file paths and memory resources
inputs: 模型图定义或NNRt构图参数 / model graph definition or NNRt graph-building parameters
离线模型文件路径或模型缓存文件路径 / offline model file path or model cache file path
输入张量数据及其维度、数据类型、布局信息 / input tensor data with shapes, data types, and layout information
设备选择、性能模式、优先级、FP16等编译与执行配置 / device selection, performance mode, priority, FP16, and other compilation/execution options
outputs: NNRt内部模型图对象（OH_NNModel） / NNRt internal model graph object (OH_NNModel)
模型编译对象（OH_NNCompilation） / model compilation object (OH_NNCompilation)
离线模型编译对象 / offline-model compilation object
推理执行器对象（OH_NNExecutor） / inference executor object (OH_NNExecutor)
推理输出张量或输出缓冲区数据 / inference output tensors or output buffer data
模型编译缓存文件 / model compilation cache files
AI硬件设备ID列表 / AI hardware device ID list
AI硬件设备信息（设备名称、类型、支持能力等） / AI hardware device information, such as device name, type, and capabilities
共享内存或零拷贝推理数据缓冲区 / shared-memory or zero-copy inference data buffers

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入NNRt Native接口以创建/加载模型并执行推理流程 / The code integrates NNRt native APIs to create/load a model and execute an inference flow
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show NNRt native API usage for model creation/loading plus inference execution, rather than only high-level AI service calls?

postconditions.statement: 实现中明确配置或处理了编译/执行阶段的关键参数或设备选择逻辑 / The implementation explicitly configures or handles key compile/execution parameters or device selection logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include explicit handling of runtime compilation/execution options such as device choice, performance mode, priority, FP16, or similar NNRt settings?

postconditions.statement: 推理输入输出张量或共享内存数据通路已被正确接线到NNRt执行过程 / Inference input/output tensors or a shared-memory data path are correctly wired into the NNRt execution process
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there a clear data path from prepared input buffers/tensors into NNRt execution and retrieval or handling of outputs?

postconditions.statement: 若场景涉及离线模型或缓存，代码已体现相应的加载、保存或复用逻辑 / If the scenario involves offline models or caching, the code includes the corresponding load, save, or reuse logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits mention offline models or caching, do they actually implement load/save/reuse handling for those artifacts?
